responseText: Knew someone'd come sniffin' 'round for hero work. Hope you've got a grip on all that sparkly magic you've been fiddlin' with, you'll need every trick you've got if you're plannin' to chase those poor fools into the deep. I'm not goin' down there again, not for twice the gold!
